---
title: "Model summaries, stacked over completed datasets"
format: html
---

- Model-level parameters only, as in `summary()`: patient- and diagnosis-level effects are left out, their SDs kept
- Each fit is thinned to the smallest number of draws of the model, so every completed dataset has equal weight
- R-hat: largest over fits; bulk and tail ESS: summed over fits (within-fit values, not those of the stacked draws)

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(here)
library(arrow)
library(posterior)
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)

# Saved fits are rstanarm, brms and rmsb objects; their methods need the
# namespaces loaded.
loadNamespace("rstanarm")
loadNamespace("brms")
loadNamespace("rmsb")

results_dir <- here("analysis", "14-model-summaries", "results")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: model-files
#| include: false

fits_in <- function(..., pattern = "^model-[0-9]+\\.rds$") {
  paths <- list.files(here("analysis", ...), pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  stopifnot("No saved fits." = length(paths) > 0)
  paths
}
os <- function(...) here("analysis", "02-overall-survival", ...)
count_dir <- function(analysis) here("analysis", analysis, "results")

# File-name prefixes of the PFS, BSC and second-line fits.
adjustment_names <- c(
  unadjusted = "unadjusted",
  fixed = "adjusted (fixed)",
  os_adjusted = "adjusted (fixed)",
  hierarchical = "adjusted (hierarchical)",
  diagnosis = "adjusted (hierarchical)"
)
survival_models <- function(analysis, outcome_names, section) {
  tibble(path = fits_in(analysis, "results", "models", pattern = "\\.rds$")) |>
    mutate(
      outcome = str_extract(basename(path), "cause_specific|composite") |> coalesce("pfs"),
      adjustment = adjustment_names[str_extract(basename(path), "^[a-z_]+")],
      model = str_glue("{outcome_names[outcome]}, {adjustment}"),
      section = section
    ) |>
    arrange(match(outcome, names(outcome_names)), match(adjustment, unique(adjustment_names)))
}

  "07-blood-products", "Erythrocyte concentrates", "model-zi-erythrocytes-adjusted.rds",

  "08-tissue-biopsy", "Days with a tissue biopsy", "model-adjusted.rds",

  "08-tissue-biopsy", "Days with a tissue biopsy", "model-zi-adjusted.rds",
  "08-tissue-biopsy", "Days with a tissue biopsy", "model-zi-unadjusted.rds",
  "09-imaging", "Imaging examinations", "model-adjusted.rds",
  "09-imaging", "Imaging examinations", "model-unadjusted.rds",
  "09-imaging", "Imaging examinations", "model-zi-adjusted.rds",
  "09-imaging", "Imaging examinations", "model-zi-unadjusted.rds",
  "11-weekly-treatment", "Weeks with anticancer treatment", "model-adjusted.rds",

  survival_models(

  survival_models(

  select(count_models, section, model, path),
  tibble(
    section = "Implementation",

    path = c(
      here("analysis", "10-implementation", "results", "models", str_glue("{implementation_models}.rds")),
      here("analysis", "13-other-trial", "results", "models", "recruitment.rds")
    )

) |>
  select(section, model, path) |>
  mutate(model = as.character(model))

stopifnot(
  "A saved fit is missing." = all(file.exists(model_files$path)),
  "A fit file is listed twice." = !anyDuplicated(model_files$path)
)
```

```{r}
#| label: stacked-summaries
#| include: false

# Patient-level (rmsb gammas are not in the draws, brms r_ and z_, rstanarm
# b[...]) and diagnosis-level effects, brms centred intercepts and sampler
# quantities are dropped.
dropped <- "^(r_|z_|zs_|s_|L_|Intercept|b\\[|lp__|lprior|log-posterior|mean_PPD)"

parameter_draws <- function(fit) {
  draws <- if (inherits(fit, "blrm")) {
    # rmsb stacks the chains (chain 1 first); the random-intercept SD is in omega.
    stacked <- cbind(fit$draws, fit$omega)
    n_chains <- as.integer(fit$chains)
    array(
      stacked,
      dim = c(nrow(stacked) / n_chains, n_chains, ncol(stacked)),
      dimnames = list(NULL, NULL, colnames(stacked))
    )
  } else {
    as.array(fit)
  }
  draws <- as_draws_array(draws)
  subset_draws(draws, variable = str_subset(variables(draws), dropped, negate = TRUE))
}

read_fits <- function(path) {
  object <- readRDS(path)
  if (inherits(object, c("brmsfit", "stanreg", "blrm"))) list(object) else object
}

fit_draws <- model_files |>
  mutate(
    draws = map(path, \(path) {
      out <- map(read_fits(path), parameter_draws)
      invisible(gc(verbose = FALSE))
      out
    })
  ) |>
  select(section, model, draws) |>
  unnest(draws)

stack_model <- function(draws) {
  stopifnot("The fits of a model have different parameters." = length(unique(map(draws, variables))) == 1L)
  within_fit <- imap(draws, \(d, fit) summarise_draws(d, "rhat", "ess_bulk", "ess_tail") |> mutate(fit = fit)) |>
    list_rbind() |>
    summarise(
      rhat = max(rhat),
      ess_bulk = sum(ess_bulk),
      ess_tail = sum(ess_tail),
      .by = variable
    )
  n_draws <- min(map_int(draws, ndraws))
  stacked <- draws |>
    map(\(d) {
      matrix <- unclass(as_draws_matrix(d))
      matrix[round(seq(1, nrow(matrix), length.out = n_draws)), , drop = FALSE]
    }) |>
    reduce(rbind) |>
    as_draws_matrix()
  # Constants (brms disc of the ordinal model) are not parameters.
  summarise_draws(stacked, mean, sd, ~ quantile2(.x, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))) |>
    filter(sd > 0) |>
    left_join(within_fit, by = "variable") |>
    mutate(
      order = row_number(),
      fits = length(draws),
      draws_per_fit = n_draws
    )
}

model_summaries <- fit_draws |>
  summarise(summary = list(stack_model(draws)), .by = c(section, model)) |>
  mutate(model_order = row_number()) |>
  unnest(summary) |>
  select(
    section, model, model_order, order, parameter = variable,
    estimate = mean, est_error = sd, lower = q2.5, upper = q97.5,
    rhat, ess_bulk, ess_tail, fits, draws_per_fit
  )

write_parquet(
  model_summaries,
  here(results_dir, "model-summaries.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: overview

model_summaries |>
  summarise(
    parameters = n(),
    fits = first(fits),
    draws_per_fit = first(draws_per_fit),
    max_rhat = max(rhat, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = c(section, model)
  ) |>
  kable(digits = 3)
```
